Exterior Services

The Cost of a Siding Replacement in Cincinnati, OH

Explore the costs of siding replacement in Cincinnati with Roof King & Restoration. Call today for professional siding solutions and expert service!

Replacing your siding is a great way to improve your home’s curb appeal and protect it from the elements. Whether you're considering a DIY project or hiring a siding contractor, it's important to understand the costs involved. At Roof King & Restoration, we offer high-quality siding replacement services tailored to your Cincinnati home.

While a DIY approach can seem appealing, siding replacement requires specific skills and tools. When you choose our professional services, you’re ensuring your home receives top-notch materials like vinyl, fiber cement, or wood, which will stand the test of time. Let us take the stress out of the process and help you make the best decision for your home.

How to Replace Siding Yourself in Cincinnati

If you’re thinking of replacing your siding on your own, here are the essential steps involved:

  1. Remove Old Siding: Carefully strip off the existing siding, inspecting the walls for any damage.
  2. Inspect and Repair the Underlayment: Make necessary repairs to the foundation before installing new siding.
  3. Measure and Cut New Siding: Choose from a range of siding types, such as vinyl or wood, and make accurate cuts to fit your home.
  4. Install the New Siding: Begin installation from the bottom, ensuring each panel fits snugly and is level.
  5. Finish Edges and Seal: Use proper caulking and trim to seal edges for a polished, weather-resistant finish.

While DIY can save money upfront, it’s a physically demanding task that requires precision and safety precautions.

Why Hiring a Professional Siding Company in Cincinnati is the Better Choice

While doing the job yourself can be tempting, there are several key benefits to hiring a professional siding contractor:

  • Expert Installation: Roof King & Restoration’s skilled team ensures your siding is installed correctly, extending its lifespan.
  • Access to Quality Materials: We offer top-quality siding options, including energy-efficient choices that may not be available to DIYers.
  • Time-Saving: We work quickly and efficiently, allowing you to avoid the hassle and stress of doing the work yourself.
  • Warranties and Guarantees: Our siding installations come with warranties, giving you peace of mind that your investment is protected.

records.rawContent:
Exterior Services

The Cost of New Gutters in Dayton, OH

Looking for gutter replacement in Dayton? Roof King & Restoration offers seamless gutters, gutter guards, and expert installation. Call for a free estimate!

Gutters are an essential part of protecting your home from water damage. Over time, gutters can become clogged, cracked, or ineffective. When this happens, gutter replacement becomes necessary to ensure your home’s foundation and exterior remain in good condition. In Dayton, Roof King & Restoration offers professional gutter replacement services, including seamless gutters and gutter guards to enhance your home’s water management system.

If you're considering replacing your gutters on your own, it's important to understand the cost and work involved. While replacing gutters yourself can seem like a money-saving option, it requires specific tools, expertise, and time. Let’s explore the DIY process, and then we’ll look at the benefits of hiring a professional.

How to Replace Gutters Yourself in Dayton

If you’re ready to tackle gutter replacement yourself in Dayton, here are the basic steps you need to follow:

  1. Measure and Remove Old Gutters: Measure the length of your roofline, then carefully remove the existing gutters, making sure to clear out debris.
  2. Install Gutter Hangers and Downspouts: Secure gutter hangers along the roofline and attach the downspouts in the desired positions.
  3. Cut and Attach New Gutters: Cut the new gutters to fit and ensure they slope correctly toward the downspouts.
  4. Seal Joints and Attach Gutter Guards: Use gutter sealant to seal the joints between sections and add gutter guards to prevent debris buildup.
  5. Test the System: Once the gutters are in place, test the system by running water through them to check for proper flow and no leaks.

While this DIY project may save you money in materials, it can be physically demanding, time-consuming, and difficult if you lack experience.

Why Hiring Roof King for Gutter Replacement in Dayton is the Better Choice

There are several key benefits to hiring a professional gutter company, such as Roof King & Restoration, for your gutter replacement needs:

  • Expert Installation: Our skilled team ensures your new gutters are installed correctly, with optimal slope and seamless connections to prevent leaks.
  • Quality Materials: We offer high-quality materials, including seamless gutters and durable gutter guards, that provide lasting protection for your home.
  • Time-Saving: We handle the entire process quickly and efficiently, so you can avoid the hassle of measuring, cutting, and installing yourself.
  • Protection & Warranty: When you hire our experts, you also get the added benefit of warranties on our products and services, ensuring peace of mind for years to come.

records.rawContent:
Columbus roofing

Columbus, OH Roof Replacement Company

When an aging, leaking, or storm-damaged roof can no longer protect your home with confidence, Roof King & Restoration helps you plan a replacement that is clear, durable, and built for Ohio weather.

As a GAF Master Elite contractor serving Columbus and Central Ohio, Roof King helps homeowners compare repair, replacement, financing, and warranty options before committing to a full roof system.

Repair or replace

Know When A Full Roof Replacement Makes Sense

Not every roofing issue needs a tear-off. If damage is isolated, a targeted roof repair may be the smarter path. If leaks keep returning, shingles are failing across multiple slopes, or storm damage has compromised the system, replacement can protect the home more completely.

Repair May Fit

Small leaks, a few missing shingles, minor flashing issues, or localized wind damage can often be addressed without replacing the entire roof.

Replacement May Fit

Older roofing, widespread granule loss, curling shingles, soft decking, recurring leaks, or damage across several areas can point toward a full system replacement.

Storm Damage Matters

Hail, wind, ice, and heavy Ohio weather can shorten a roof system's life. Our team can inspect the roof and document what we find before you decide.

Warning signs

Signs You May Need Roof Replacement

Homeowners usually call when a leak becomes obvious, but many replacement clues show up earlier. Watch for missing or lifted shingles, curling edges, bald spots where granules have washed away, dark streaking, repeated repairs, daylight in the attic, soft or sagging decking, damaged flashing, ventilation problems, and roof age that is approaching the end of its expected life.

A complete inspection helps separate cosmetic wear from problems that can let water reach the decking, insulation, drywall, and interior finishes of your home.

Installation process

A Roof Replacement Process Built Around Clarity

Roof King keeps the project straightforward from inspection to cleanup. You get a clear scope, product guidance, schedule expectations, and a finished system designed to handle rain, wind, heat, ice, and everyday Ohio weather.

Inspection And Estimate

We review shingles, flashing, decking, ventilation, storm damage, and leak history before recommending the right path.

Material Selection

Choose colors, shingle profiles, ventilation, underlayment, and warranty options that fit the home and budget.

Tear-Off And Installation

Our crew removes the old system, checks the decking, installs protection layers, and completes the roofing system with care.

Cleanup And Walkthrough

We clean the property, check the finished details, and walk through the completed work before the project wraps.

Materials and cost

Roofing Systems, Cost Factors, And Warranty Protection

The right roof is more than the visible shingle. Material choice, ventilation, flashing, underlayment, decking condition, labor, disposal, pitch, access, and warranty coverage all affect the finished result and the final price.

Roofing Materials

Roof King installs asphalt shingles, architectural shingles, metal roofing, and premium GAF roofing systems. Compare more options on our roof types page.

Replacement Cost

Size, pitch, tear-off needs, decking repairs, ventilation, warranty selections, and storm conditions all matter. Start with our roof replacement cost guide or roofing calculator.

Warranty Coverage

Our work is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty, and GAF product options may provide additional manufacturer protection depending on the system selected.

Storm And Insurance Support

When wind, hail, ice, or falling debris is involved, we can inspect the damage and help you understand next steps. Learn more about storm damage restoration and insurance claims.

Roof replacement FAQs

Answers Before You Replace Your Roof

Use these questions to understand scope, timing, warranty, and when replacement is the right move for your home.

How do I know if I need a roof replacement?

You may need replacement if your roof has widespread shingle wear, recurring leaks, storm damage across multiple slopes, soft decking, sagging areas, or age-related failure that repairs cannot reliably solve.

How long does a roof replacement take?

Many residential roof replacements can be completed quickly once materials and scheduling are set. In Columbus and Central Ohio, timing can also depend on seasonal weather, storm demand, material scheduling, roof size, pitch, decking repairs, and project complexity.

How much does roof replacement cost in Columbus, OH?

Cost depends on roof size, pitch, tear-off needs, material, ventilation, decking condition, labor, disposal, and warranty selections. Our roof cost guide and calculator can help you start planning.

Do you tear off the old roof?

Roof King evaluates the existing system and recommends the right installation approach. A tear-off often gives the crew a clearer look at decking, flashing, and hidden water damage.

What roofing materials do you install?

We install asphalt shingles, architectural shingles, metal roofing, and GAF roofing systems, with color and style options selected for Ohio homes, curb appeal, and year-round weather exposure.

Do you offer financing?

Yes. Roof King offers financing options that can help homeowners plan roofing, windows, gutters, siding, decks, and other exterior projects.

What warranty comes with a roof replacement?

Roof King provides a 5-year workmanship warranty, and manufacturer warranty options may be available through GAF depending on the roofing system selected.

Can storm damage qualify for insurance coverage?

Wind, hail, ice, and other Central Ohio storm events may qualify depending on the damage, policy, and inspection findings. Our team can document roof conditions and help you understand the next steps.

Do you replace damaged decking?

If decking is soft, rotted, or compromised, it should be addressed before the new roofing system is completed. We review decking during the project and explain any needed repairs.

Do you serve areas outside Columbus?

Yes. Roof King serves Columbus, Central Ohio, and communities across Ohio for roofing, storm damage, siding, gutters, windows, decks, and attic insulation.

The longevity of your roof system depends greatly on roofing materials of the construction. So if you seek the most efficient roofing solution, ask certified specialists from Roof King & Restoration for professional help. We specialize in residential roofing to assist property owners with their roof installation, repair, and replacement needs.

With so many options to choose from these days, picking the right color shingles for your homes' roof can be a challenge. Roof King & Restoration is a proud certified partner with GAF, one of the largest residential shingle manufacturers. We believe in GAF's products and the warranty they offer.

GAF Roof System

A roof replacement is an investment that you shouldn't hesitate on. Since your roof protects your interior the most, you shouldn't pick anything but the best as a replacement.

New HDZ Shingle

The new Timberline HDZ Shingles are compatible with traditional Timberline HD Shingles for the same look and feel homeowners and contractors rely on for beauty and endurance.

7 Key Danger Signs

Don't get caught with sudden, costly repairs. Keep a close eye on your roof and find out how to spot problems, including these 7 key danger signs - before they severely impact your wallet

Look For:

  • Rook Leaks: After a strong storm or wind-driven rain, take a look in the attic for signs of leaking. It could indicate damaged shingles, inadequate underlayment or deteriorated flashing.
  • Stains: Stains, or worse, mold, can be caused by leaks from outside the house or moisture trapped inside.
  • Blistering/Peeling Paint: Moisture trapped in the house due to poor ventilation can cause exterior paint to peel and blister.
  • Exterior Decay: Excess moisture can also contribute to decay.

records.description: Roof King & Restoration offers expert ice dam removal in Columbus, OH. Act now to protect your home this winter—schedule safe, fast service today!
records.rawContent:
Prevent Roof Damage This Winter with Ice Dam Removal in Columbus, OH

By Jared L. December 04, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

If you’ve lived through a few winters in Columbus, OH, you know how quickly snow and ice can build up on rooftops. What many homeowners don’t realize is just how dangerous this build-up can be—especially when it forms ice dams. These thick ridges of ice along your roof’s edge can cause costly leaks, structural damage, and even mold growth if left untreated. That’s where we come in.

At Roof King & Restoration, we specialize in ice dam removal in Columbus, OH, using safe, effective techniques that protect your roof and prevent long-term damage. Even in the off-season, winter maintenance matters. Taking action now can save you thousands in repairs later.

What Are Ice Dams and Why Are They a Problem?

Ice dams form when snow on your roof melts, then refreezes near the edges, usually above the eaves. The melted water gets trapped behind these ridges of ice and starts to seep underneath your shingles. Once that water makes its way inside, it can damage ceilings, walls, insulation, and more.

In Columbus, where snow and freezing temps are common in December and beyond, ice dams are a serious risk to your roofing system. Regular roof maintenance and ice dam removal can help you avoid:

  • Leaks and water stains inside your home

  • Rotted wood in your attic or roof deck

  • Mold and mildew from trapped moisture

  • Damage to gutters and shingles

  • Expensive structural repairs in the spring

Safe and Professional Ice Dam Removal in Columbus, OH

Trying to remove an ice dam yourself can be dangerous and ineffective. Chiseling, hammering, or using salt can actually make the problem worse or damage your roof. That’s why it’s essential to hire professionals like Roof King & Restoration. We use low-pressure steam to remove ice dams safely and gently without harming your roofing materials.

We also assess what may have caused the ice dam in the first place—such as poor attic ventilation or insulation—and recommend solutions to help you prevent future issues.

Signs You May Need Ice Dam Removal

If you’re unsure whether you need ice dam removal services, keep an eye out for these signs:

  • Icicles hanging from the roof edge

  • Water stains on ceilings or walls

  • Ice buildup along the gutters

  • Sagging gutters or soffits

  • A consistently cold attic

When in doubt, don’t wait. It’s always better to have a professional take a look before the problem gets worse.

Protect Your Home This Winter with Ice Dam Removal in Columbus, OH

Winter might be the off-season for some home improvements, but it’s peak time for problems like ice dams. At Roof King & Restoration, we help Columbus homeowners stay ahead of winter damage with expert ice dam removal, roofing services, and seasonal maintenance.

If you notice signs of an ice dam—or just want to make sure your roof is ready for another Ohio winter—reach out to our team today. We’re here to keep your home safe, dry, and protected all season long.

records.rawContent:
Columbus Roofs Face Wind Gusts Over 40 MPH During Fall Storms—Enough to Lift Shingles or Expose Underlayment

By Jared L. October 29, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

If you live in Columbus, OH, you know fall weather isn’t just about crisp mornings and football Saturdays. Our region regularly sees wind gusts topping 40 mph during autumn storms. While that may not sound extreme, those gusts are more than enough to lift loose shingles, expose your roof’s underlayment, or even tear away flashing around chimneys and vents.

At Roof King, we’ve seen firsthand how quickly a strong windstorm can turn a minor roofing issue into a costly repair. That’s why we believe in proactive care—especially when fall rolls around in central Ohio.

How Fall Winds Damage Columbus Roofs

In Columbus, wind damage ranks among the most common fall insurance claims for homeowners. Seasonal cold fronts bring rapid pressure changes that whip up short but powerful wind bursts. These conditions are especially hard on older roofs or those with poor attic ventilation.

Here’s what your roof goes up against during a typical Columbus fall storm:

  • Gusts over 40 mph that pull at shingles and flashing

  • Tree limbs weakened by summer growth snapping onto the roof

  • Water intrusion from lifted edges or missing sealant

  • Cold air inflows that worsen attic condensation if not properly vented

Even newer roofs can be affected if installed without wind-rated shingles or if basic maintenance has been overlooked.

Before vs. After Windstorm Roof Inspection Checklist

Performing quick visual checks before and after a storm helps you catch small problems early. Use this simple checklist to stay ahead of the damage:

Before the Windstorm:

  • Look for curling, cracked, or missing shingles

  • Check flashing around chimneys and roof valleys

  • Ensure gutters are securely fastened

  • Trim any overhanging tree limbs

  • Check for signs of mold or mildew in the attic

After the Windstorm:

  • Scan the yard for fallen shingles or debris

  • Inspect attic for new leaks or daylight through roof boards

  • Look for damaged vent caps or bent flashing

  • Note water stains on ceilings or walls inside the home

If you spot any of these signs, it’s best to schedule a professional roof inspection immediately.

Protect Your Columbus Home with Preventative Roofing Steps

When it comes to fall roof maintenance, a little effort goes a long way. We recommend Columbus homeowners take these key steps before peak storm season hits:

  • Schedule attic ventilation checks: Poor ventilation can lead to condensation and weakened roof decking.

  • Install or upgrade to wind-rated shingles: Designed to resist uplift, these shingles help prevent future storm damage.​

  • Secure flashing and seals: Especially around skylights, vents, and chimneys.

  • Trim back nearby trees: Prevent large limbs from falling onto your roof during gusty weather.

These preventative measures not only save money on future repairs, but also extend the life of your roof.

Ready to Storm-Proof Your Roof in Columbus, OH? Ask About Wind-Rated Shingles and Maintenance Packages

Don’t wait for the next 40+ mph gust to reveal a problem. At Roof King, we help Columbus homeowners stay a step ahead with professional inspections, wind-rated shingles, and affordable maintenance packages.

Call us today to schedule your fall roof check-up and learn more about options designed to handle the worst Ohio weather throws your way.

records.rawContent:
From Hail to High Winds: How to Spot Hidden Roof Damage After Ohio’s Late-Summer Storms

By Jared L. October 08, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

How do I know if my roof was damaged in a storm?

Check for signs like lifted shingles, missing granules, or bent flashing—these often signal hidden issues that can worsen with the next rainfall.

Late summer in Ohio can be unpredictable. This year, Columbus saw a burst of hailstorms in August followed by strong wind gusts in September. While some damage is obvious, others—like shingle lifting or subtle leaks—can go unnoticed until they turn into costly repairs.

As your local roofing experts, we want to help Ohio homeowners stay ahead of storm-related roofing problems. Even if your roof looks fine from the ground, hidden damage might already be letting in moisture. That’s why it’s essential to inspect your roof after every major storm—especially before fall rain soaks the region.

What Hidden Roof Damage Should Ohio Homeowners Look For?

Storm damage isn’t always as visible as a missing shingle or a gaping hole. In many cases, roof issues start small and worsen over time—especially with the seasonal transition from dry weather to damp fall conditions.

Some of the most common issues after storms in Ohio include:

  • Lifted shingles that may not reseal, leaving your roof vulnerable to water infiltration.

  • Granule loss from hail impacts, which exposes shingles to UV rays and speeds up wear.

  • Cracked or dislodged flashing around chimneys, vents, and skylights, leading to leaks.

  • Dented gutters or downspouts, indicating hail impact and potential water backup.

  • Subtle ceiling stains, which may be the first sign of a slow-developing leak.

Even if you're not comfortable climbing onto your roof, spotting changes from the ground or attic can be a red flag that it’s time to call a professional.

5 Signs You Need a Roof Inspection After a Storm:

  • Shingles appear curled, cracked, or missing

records.rawContent:
Storm-Ready Roofing: Protecting Your Home from Fall & Winter Storms

By Jared L. September 17, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

Do you live in an area prone to storms from wind, hail, heavy rain, or snow? By conducting detailed inspections and making immediate repairs, protecting your roof is the key to creating a stronger home. You can never be too prepared for fall storms and blizzards, but using these checklists can help.

Pre-Storm Checklist: Storm Damage Roof Prep

The best way to protect your home from storm damage is by taking proactive steps. Each area of your exterior plays a crucial role in defending your home, so addressing small issues ahead of time can save you from costly repairs down the line. Some pre-storm steps you should take include:

  • Inspecting Shingles: Check the vulnerable areas of your roofing system to make sure they’re ready for fall and winter force by looking for loose, curled, or missing shingles. It helps to schedule a professional roof inspection to spot concerns you may have missed.
  • Securing Flashing: Look for gaps around chimneys, vents, and skylights to make sure your home is properly sealed from the weather.
  • Clearing Gutters: This is the time to properly clean your gutters and remove leaves and debris that can cause your gutters to back up, freeze, or leak.
  • Checking Attic Ventilation: Poor ventilation can cause moisture to build up, leading to winter ice damming.

Post-Storm Checklist: How to Protect Your Roof from Storms After Damage

It’s important to inspect the condition of your roofing system as soon as it’s safe following a storm. Between fallen trees, heavy snowfall, and ice accumulation, the fall and winter months can slowly weaken your exterior. Take a thorough look around your entire property to spot leaks, missing shingles, and interior stains that can all be signs of further issues. Some key areas to inspect are

  • Missing Shingles and Granule Loss
  • Flashing or Chimney Gaps
  • Bent or Clogged Gutters and Downspouts
  • Stains on Ceiling or Walls

Learn More From a Professional Roofing Contractor in Ohio

Don’t let storm damage in Ohio have a lasting effect on your property when you can get professional assistance. Roof King Roofing & Restoration is here to thoroughly defend your property with immediate storm damage protection and roofing insurance claims assistance. As a local storm damage expert, we’re prepared for the harsh fall and winter weather with comprehensive roofing, repair, gutter, and ventilation services. Begin your fall and winter storm preparations today by scheduling a free inspection.

records.rawContent:
Why Gutter Guard Installation in Columbus, OH is a Good Idea

By Jared L. August 09, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

When planning a gutter replacement in Columbus, OH, you might be asking yourself, “Are gutter guards worth it?” When investing in new gutters, adding gutter guards is a wise choice.

In this article, you can find out more about the immediate benefits you can gain when adding gutter guards to your gutter replacement, get answers to common questions about gutter guards, and then find a local gutter company that provides the products and installation service you need!

5 Benefits of Quality Gutter Guards in Columbus, OH

Functional gutters are essential for the protection of your home’s roofing and siding, and they help prevent erosion and damage to your home’s foundation.

With so much at stake, it makes sense to take every measure to ensure your gutters are working as they should. This is where gutter guards come in. Here are some of the key benefits you will gain:

1. Clog Prevention

Gutter guards are designed to keep clogs from forming that impede water drainage. This can include leaves, twigs, nests, seeds, and shingle grit.

2. Water Damage Defense

Keeping your gutters clog-free helps prevent roof water damage, fascia rot, and ensures that water is directed away from the foundation, thereby protecting your home from soil erosion and basement leaks.

3. Ice-Dam & Pest Mitigation

Gutter guards reduce winter ice dams by preventing clogs that trap snow and sleet. They also keep rodents, birds, and insects from building nests in your gutters, and eventually, making their way into other structures of your home.

4. Maintenance Savings

You can reduce your time on a ladder cleaning your gutters by 63%, or in other words, save about 4 hours each year on home chores. If you pay for gutter cleaning services, then that’s more money kept in your bank account.

5. Insurance & ROI

Gutter guards are considered one of the top weather-proofing upgrades for your home. They can help avoid storm damage claims as well. Because of these benefits, you could save on homeowner’s insurance. Plus, the money saved on exterior repairs is a long-term investment that many consider well worth the initial cost.

Gutter Guard FAQs

Even though there are numerous reasons to invest in gutter guards, you want to be fully informed anytime you’re investing in your home. Here are some common questions and answers about gutter guards to help.

Do Gutter Guards Work During Heavy Rain?

When the rain is very heavy and coming down fast, some gutter guards are unable to keep up. When this happens, rain bypasses the gutter entirely. However, this can happen even without gutter guards during intense storms.

Can Gutter Guards Save Money?

Gutter guards save money in multiple ways, including reducing the need for gutter maintenance, repairs, and replacement. They also help prevent costly damage to your home. It’s essential to weigh the upfront cost of gutter guard installation with the potential for long-term savings.

How Long Do Gutter Guards Last?

The lifespan of gutter guards depends on the type of guards used and the local climate. For example, aluminum gutter guards can last 10-20 years, while vinyl gutter guards last 2-10 years on average.

Do you want to learn more about gutter guards, or are you ready to contact a local gutter company in Columbus, OH? Reach out to Roof King & Restoration today!

records.description: Looking for storm restoration contractors in Columbus? Contact Roof King & Restoration today for a free quote and more details on our roof restoration services.
records.rawContent:
Post-Storm Roof Inspection Checklist: What to Do Before Calling Insurance

By Jared L. July 02, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

Many areas of the Midwest are projected to see a stormier summer than usual in 2025, and Columbus is no exception. Situated along the Scioto River in Central Ohio, the state's capital experiences its fair share of severe storms throughout the year, but summer tends to bring the most volatile weather. From high winds to hailstorms to heavy rain, there are plenty of elemental conditions that can leave homes damaged in their wake.

As a trusted Columbus roofing company, Roof King & Restoration encourages customers to familiarize themselves with the post-storm roof restoration process in the event that their homes sustain damage from one of the summer storms projected to blow through the area. Below are the first steps homeowners should take if they suspect their roofs have been damaged by the elements.

Double-Check Your Insurance Policy

Most homeowner insurance policies outline the required steps to take in order to receive coverage for Columbus roof repairs following a storm. We suggest taking a look at your insurance policy ahead of time so that you'll know what you need to do in the event that your home is damaged. You'll likely find information like:

  • Duties After Loss: This section of your policy will detail everything you need to accomplish, from notifying your provider to protecting your property from further damage to scheduling repairs.
  • Timely Filing Requirements: Most policies will have a timeframe in which you need to notify your insurer and officially file your claim, which typically ranges from 30 to 90 days.
  • Proof of Loss: Your policy will also state what type of documentation you need to submit in order to show that your home sustained damage. This could include photographs, estimates and repair receipts.

Snap Photos of Your Roof After a Storm

Knowing common signs of storm damage can help you assess the condition of your roof. While issues like vegetation growth or discoloration may be simply due to its age, there are many other problems that indicate elemental damage occurred. After a storm, we recommend looking for and snapping photos of the following 11 most typical signs of storm damage:

  1. Missing Roof Materials
  2. Curled, Loosened or Cracked Shingles
  3. Ceiling or Attic Leaks
  4. Broken Gutters and Downspouts
  5. Damaged Soffits, Fascia and Flashing
  6. Sagging or Drooping Structure
  7. Pockmarked or Dented Materials
  8. Granule Loss on Shingles
  9. Debris on Roof
  10. Exposed Underlayment
  11. Damaged Roof Vents

Schedule a Professional Roof Inspection

Next up, it's time to contact a trusted storm restoration contractor. Delaying necessary repairs can be catastrophic for homeowners, as it could lead to being denied coverage by insurance companies. Procrastinating proper maintenance can also result in small roofing issues snowballing into larger and more serious deterioration, presenting safety hazards to you and your family. 

An experienced roofing contractor will complete a thorough roof inspection, document all signs of damage, and complete any necessary repairs. Roof King & Restoration can even communicate with your provider on your behalf, making the entire insurance claim process much easier and less stressful.

As a Columbus GAF roofer, another one of the many perks of our storm restoration service is the materials we use. GAF manufactures some of the most durable and reliable roofing products available, which offer resistance to high winds, torrential rains, and much more. It also means that a Columbus roof replacement with our team will be accompanied by strong warranty protection for the ultimate peace of mind.

Get in touch with Roof King & Restoration today to receive a free estimate on our roof restoration services, and learn more about all that we can do to help you protect your Columbus home.

From high winds to hailstorms to heavy rain, there are plenty of elemental conditions that can leave homes damaged in their wake.

As a trusted Columbus roofing company, Roof King & Restoration encourages customers to familiarize themselves with the post-storm roof restoration process in the event that their homes sustain damage from one of the summer storms projected to blow through the area. Below are the first steps homeowners should take if they suspect their roofs have been damaged by the elements.

Double-Check Your Insurance Policy

Most homeowner insurance policies outline the required steps to take in order to receive coverage for Columbus roof repairs following a storm. We suggest taking a look at your insurance policy ahead of time so that you'll know what you need to do in the event that your home is damaged. You'll likely find information like:

  • Duties After Loss: This section of your policy will detail everything you need to accomplish, from notifying your provider to protecting your property from further damage to scheduling repairs.
  • Timely Filing Requirements: Most policies will have a timeframe in which you need to notify your insurer and officially file your claim, which typically ranges from 30 to 90 days.
  • Proof of Loss: Your policy will also state what type of documentation you need to submit in order to show that your home sustained damage. This could include photographs, estimates and repair receipts.

Snap Photos of Your Roof After a Storm

Knowing common signs of storm damage can help you assess the condition of your roof. While issues like vegetation growth or discoloration may be simply due to its age, there are many other problems that indicate elemental damage occurred. After a storm, we recommend looking for and snapping photos of the following 11 most typical signs of storm damage:

  1. Missing Roof Materials
  2. Curled, Loosened or Cracked Shingles
  3. Ceiling or Attic Leaks
  4. Broken Gutters and Downspouts
  5. Damaged Soffits, Fascia and Flashing
  6. Sagging or Drooping Structure
  7. Pockmarked or Dented Materials
  8. Granule Loss on Shingles
  9. Debris on Roof
  10. Exposed Underlayment
  11. Damaged Roof Vents

Schedule a Professional Roof Inspection

Next up, it's time to contact a trusted storm restoration contractor. Delaying necessary repairs can be catastrophic for homeowners, as it could lead to being denied coverage by insurance companies. Procrastinating proper maintenance can also result in small roofing issues snowballing into larger and more serious deterioration, presenting safety hazards to you and your family. 

An experienced roofing contractor will complete a thorough roof inspection, document all signs of damage, and complete any necessary repairs. Roof King & Restoration can even communicate with your provider on your behalf, making the entire insurance claim process much easier and less stressful.

GAF manufactures some of the most durable and reliable roofing products available, which offer resistance to high winds, torrential rains, and much more. It also means that a Columbus roof replacement with our team will be accompanied by strong warranty protection for the ultimate peace of mind.

How to Spot Roof Damage This Storm Season

By Jared L. June 10, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

When storm season arrives in your area, it's important to know the signs of damage to your roof. Your roof takes the brunt of the force from a storm, so you must ensure it's in tip-top shape.

As an experienced Columbus roofing company, we have helped repair numerous storm damages for our customers. This article will cover how to spot roofing damage during this storm season. 

Missing or Damaged Shingles 

The shingles of your roofing system will give you a clear picture of the damage it sustained. Broken or missing shingles are an obvious sign that your roof needs a repair service.

You can spot these signs of damage by walking around your property and looking for pieces of broken shingles in the grass. These broken shingles can lead your property to deal with leaks and structural problems.

Water Stains Indoors

Water stains on the ceiling or walls are a sign that your roofing system is experiencing a leak. Brownish or yellow spots are generally a sign that water is dripping into the home and then drying. 

When you spot water stains, you should not hesitate to schedule an inspection for the roof. The longer you wait, the greater the chance of a costly repair for your roofing system.

Sagging Roofing Sections

If you spot a sagging roofing section, this requires immediate assistance from a reputable Columbus GAF roofer. A sagging roof means there are structural problems caused by continuous water exposure. 

Once the roof reaches a point where it's sagging, the underlying decking and supports are compromised. If left unfixed, it could lead to a collapse of the roofing system. 

Overflowing Gutters

When gutters fill with broken shingle fragments and granules, they can start to clog. After a severe storm, you should check your gutters for any signs of debris from your roofing system. 

Things like shingle granules in a gutter mean it is deteriorating and needs repair. Additionally, having a gutter overflow can also mean there is a problem with the flashing.

How to Know If You Need a Roof Repair or Roof Replacement

By Jared L. May 20, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

When homeowners start to face roofing issues, they often wonder if a roof repair is enough or if a roof replacement is necessary. The answer to your roofing damage will depend on several factors. 

As an experienced roofer, our team at Roof King & Restoration has handled roof repairs and roof replacements. This article will cover which option is likely the right choice for your situation. 

Age of the Roof

Most asphalt roofing systems have a lifespan of 20 to 25 years. If your roofing system is nearing this age, a roof replacement is often a more cost-effective solution. 

You will need to perform repeated repairs and eventually replace the roof if you push the roof replacement to a later date. If you are unsure about the age of your property's roof, a professional inspection can help identify common signs of age. 

Shingle Damage

If your roofing system only has a few damaged shingles, it can be repaired without a roof replacement. However, having widespread shingle damage like curling, cracking, or missing pieces is often a sign of a roof replacement.

Additionally, you should look for shingles that are covered in dark streaks or have granular loss. The dark streaks are often a sign of algae and moisture in the roofing system that requires replacement. 

Water Leaks and Stains 

A minor hole in a roofing system that leads to a water leak can be patched and restored. However, if you are facing persistent water leaks and stains on your home's ceiling, this is a sign that you need a roof replacement quickly. 

Water intrusion in your home can lead to mold growth and structural problems. If you notice water leaks, you shouldn't hesitate to contact a Columbus roofing company like Roof King & Restoration for help.

records.rawContent:
Should I Go with GAF Shingles for My Roof Replacement?

By Jared L. April 09, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

Every roof will reach the natural end of its lifespan eventually, and when that happens, it's important to make an informed decision on what type of roofing materials to get installed on top of your home next. Even if you know you want asphalt shingles installed, the question becomes, which brand is best?

Roof King & Restoration is a trusted Columbus roofing company that provides a wide range of solutions, from roof repairs to replacements, residential to commercial, gutters, storm damage and more. As a GAF Master Elite Contractor, we strongly believe in the performance offered by GAF shingles, and recommend them for all of our complete roof replacement projects.

Impressive Performance

GAF roofs stand out among asphalt roofs for their enhanced performance. Special features, including GAF's LayerLock, Dura Grip and and StainGuard technologies help these products adhere tightly to each other and the roof itself, as well as protect against excess moisture and potential water damage. GAF also manufactures its roofing materials to meet the highest possible Class 4 impact rating, as well as a Class A fire rating for the ultimate peace of mind.

This means that GAF products can perform well through a variety of extreme weather events, including:

  • High Wind Speeds
  • Hailstorms
  • Torrential Rains
  • Intense Heat and Sunshine
  • Below-Freezing Temperatures

Cost Effectiveness

GAF shingles are also considered cost-efficient, making them an excellent option for any Columbus roof replacement. Even though their products offer a top-shelf performance, GAF keeps its prices competitive and customer-driven.

Depending on what's best for your home and budget, GAF offers a wide variety of products to accommodate different needs or preferences. For the most affordability, you can shop a variety of classic 3-tab options, all coming with reliable weather resistance and decades-long protection. On the other hand, GAF also manufactures premium designer shingle lines for those interested in a luxury option.

Stunning and Stylish

Homeowners that get a roof replacement featuring GAF shingles aren't just signing up for improved durability and long-lasting performance—these products also offer a beautiful aesthetic. The brand's Designer Shingle Series, for example, come in a variety of styles, including traditional, architectural and premium, and can mimic the look of other roofing materials, such as wood or slate, contributing to the curb appeal at any address.

GAF also manufactures a wide range of color options. This way, homeowners are able to perfectly complement their home and property by selecting the perfect color for their new roof replacement.

In order to get these elite benefits out of your roof replacement, it's important to work with a knowledgeable Columbus GAF roofer. Roof King has been recognized by the brand for the quality of our installations that feature their materials, which lets our customers know that we can offer superior craftsmanship and ensure they receive all the aforementioned advantages out of their next roof replacement.

Get in touch with Roof King today for more information, and we'll give you a free estimate on a complete roof replacement featuring premium GAF materials.

records.rawContent:
The 5 Step Roofing Process

By Jared L. March 21, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

​Replacing your roof can be a significant investment, and it's a good idea to understand the process. At Roof King & Restoration, we believe in providing transparent services for our customers.

The Columbus roof replacement services that we provide can be broken up into five steps. This article will cover the roofing installation process from start to finish. 

Initial Consultation

The first step of any roofing replacement is a thorough consultation and roofing inspection. A team will come to assess the condition of your roofing system and discuss goals with you.

Whether you are dealing with severe damage or wear and tear, the consultation helps to tailor the service to your needs. Additionally, this is a time for the customer to ask about project details.

Customized Plan and Estimate

Once the roof has been evaluated, a plan will be customized for the scope of work, materials, and timeline. The plan helps to set standards and a schedule for the roofing installation.

Additionally, the plan will come with a transparent estimate that breaks down the costs of the service. The goal is to ensure that there are no surprises during the roofing replacement process.

Material Selection and Preparation

Choosing the right material is crucial for getting the best results and performance from your new roof. A roofing company will guide you through the process of choosing a roofing style. 

Some of the most popular roofing styles include:

  • Asphalt Shingles
  • Slate Roofing
  • ​Metal Roofing​
  • Clay Tiles 

Professional Roofing Installation

The service starts with the removal of old materials and the installation of new ones. A reputable roofer will follow industry guidelines and ensure everything is installed correctly. 

Throughout the process, you will receive updates on its completion and the next steps. At Roof King & Restoration, we value constant communication with our Columbus customers. 

Final Inspection and Site Cleanup

Once the installation is complete, we will conduct a final inspection of all features of the roofing system. We will walk around with you and point out key features of the roofing system.

Additionally, we will provide an in-depth cleanup of the job site and leave it as tidy as how we found it. We emphasize treating our customer's homes with respect and take pride in helping them. 

Request a Free Roofing Replacement Estimate Today

Roof King & Restoration is a leading Columbus roofing company with years of experience. Contact us today to request a free pricing estimate and learn more about our service options.

records.rawContent:
Replacing Your Roof in Columbus: Why Hiring Experts Is the Best Choice

By Jared L. January 15, 2025
Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

Replacing your roof is a big task that requires time, skill, and the right tools. Many homeowners in Columbus consider doing it themselves to save money. While it’s possible to handle a roof replacement on your own, it’s also risky. Without professional expertise, you may face challenges like improperly installed shingles, structural issues, or even personal injury.

At Roof King & Restoration, we believe that your roof is one of the most important parts of your home. As a trusted roofing company in Columbus, we offer professional roof installation services to ensure your roof is safe, durable, and ready to withstand the elements. From GAF roofs to metal roofs, we provide high-quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

Steps for a Successful DIY Roof Replacement in Columbus

If you’re determined to tackle the job yourself, here are the basic steps to follow:

  1. Inspect the Roof: Assess the damage and measure the area to determine material needs.
  2. Remove Old Roofing: Carefully strip off old shingles and nails, ensuring the surface is clean.
  3. Install Underlayment: Lay down weatherproof underlayment to protect against moisture.
  4. Install New Shingles or Panels: Place and secure the new roofing material, ensuring proper alignment.
  5. Finish with Sealing and Flashing: Seal edges and install flashing for added durability.

Keep in mind that Columbus weather can be unpredictable, which makes timing crucial for DIY roof replacement. If done incorrectly, you might need extensive roof repair later.

Why Hiring a Professional Roof Company Is Better

Hiring a professional roofing company like Roof King & Restoration saves time, ensures safety, and guarantees quality results. Our experienced team handles everything, from roof installation to addressing specific needs like attic insulation.

  • Expertise with Roof Types: We specialize in GAF roofs, metal roofs, and more, tailoring solutions to fit your home’s needs.
  • Peace of Mind: Our roof installations come with warranties to protect your investment.
  • Efficiency: We complete projects on schedule, minimizing disruption to your routine.

Let Us Handle Your Roof Replacement in Columbus

At Roof King & Restoration, we’re proud to be the go-to roofing company in Columbus. Whether you need roof repair, roof replacement, or a new roof installation, our skilled contractors are here to help. Trust us to deliver exceptional results with high-quality materials like GAF roofs and metal roofs.

Contact us today to schedule your free consultation and discover how we can make your roofing project stress-free!

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share via Email

Gutters are a vital part of your home’s drainage system, protecting your foundation, roof, and landscaping from water damage. Over time, wear and tear or storm damage can leave your gutters inefficient or leaking. When it’s time for a gutter replacement, you might wonder whether to take on the task yourself or hire a professional gutter company.

Replacing gutters may seem like a straightforward project, but it involves precise measurements, the right materials, and proper installation techniques. At Roof King & Restoration, we specialize in gutter replacement and seamless gutters in Columbus to ensure your home stays protected.

With our help, you can enjoy the benefits of professionally installed gutters, including improved curb appeal and a long-lasting system designed for Columbus weather. Whether you need new gutter guards or seamless gutters, we’re here to make the process simple and stress-free.

How to Replace Gutters in Columbus: A Step-by-Step Guide

If you’re thinking about replacing your gutters on your own, here are the general steps involved:

  1. Inspect and Measure: Assess your current gutters for damage and measure your roofline for precise sizing.
  2. Remove Old Gutters: Safely detach and dispose of the old system.
  3. Install New Gutters: Attach hangers and align the gutters to ensure proper slope for drainage.
  4. Add Gutter Guards: Consider installing gutter guards to minimize debris buildup.
  5. Test the System: Run water through the gutters to check for leaks and proper drainage.
